reviews.text: My last experience with Pet bath & beyond was not good,BUT this time around they did an EXCELLENT  job on my cavalier. I know we all have off days, and maybe that was the case the last time. This time around, my cavalier looks great. They did an awesome job. I’m so happy and on top of that, they gave me credit for this groom since my last one was not that good. I so appreciate businesses that pay attention to their customers and do right by us. I really like them and will continue to take my dog there. THANK YOU PET BATH&BEYOND
Been getting my sweet Emma girl groomed here at PB&B for years and I am always satisfied! I love being able to trust the groomers with my fur baby girl! ❤️
Great service

I had a scheduled appt for 8am. I had confirmed and this was my second time taking my dog to get full groom and was allowed to drop off 15 mins before the appt. This morning when I walked it was greeted very rude by the young lady upfront. She told me what you here for I told her I had an appt at 8am she was very bothered and told me that they didn't open until 8 and she was not prepared. I told her I would glady wait in the car and she was flipping paperwork and upset, I spoke with manager he did say he was sorry if I wanted to take Teddy in I could drop her off. No thank you Lost a customer.

Daniel always does an outstanding job grooming my Shih Tzu. Every time I pick up my dog up the first thing I notice is that she’s had a wonderful bath, nails cut, and her fur groomed to perfection. He is always open to hearing my suggestions on how I may want to trim my dog, but whether I make any suggestions or not, Daniel always knows what cut would make her look the best. Thank you Daniel!!

So I decided to take my dog back for the second time since they did such a good job last time. But today when I picked him up and put him in my car, I realized that my passenger seat was full of BLOOD. I looked to see where my dog was bleeding from and it was from his paw! I don't understand how you cut his nails and didn't notice he was bleeding. The groomer who took care of him was Daniel Garcia. So if I were you, I wouldn't book with him! I would post pictures but I don't want to gross anybody out!
Danny is an exceptional groomer and he takes really good care of our babies. All the staff is so friendly and accommodating.

Hi ruth, 
Thank you so much for the 5-star review! We truly appreciate your business and look forward to serving you and your pooch for many years to come. Customers like you are the reason we love what we do.

Thanks again, and we look forward to seeing you soon!

sincerely,
Alma White (owner)

Rebecca,

Thank you so much for the 5-star review! We love caring for your feline and canine friends, and our team prides itself on delivering top-tier service during every visit. Next time you come in, feel free to ask about our specialized cat grooming services so we can keep your pet looking "pawsitively purrfect." We look forward to seeing you and your fur baby again soon!

sincerely,
Alma white (owner)
They scheduled me on no business hours and get snippy with me don't care they messed up my day and no management available
They are very friendly to the customers and the pets.  ❤️
We have used the Spa & Boarding and have been completely satisfied! Highly recommend staff is very friendly and genuinely cares about your animal!

Barb,
Thank you so much for your 5 star rating. We appreciate your business and hope to see you again soon.

Warm regards, 
Alma White (owner)
Wonderful service! They truly care for your fur babies. 😍🐶
They did an excellent job grooming my shitzu, the staff is friendly and takes pride in their work. My dog always look fresh coming out and they do a good job every time.
My pup does not like to be bathed, groomed or brushed. That’s why the groomers at Per Bath & Beyond are my #1 go to for grooming. They work with her and she comes home happy, clean and well groomed.
My Whippet loves this place! She loves her bandana and is so sad when it falls off.  I feel she is taken care of, no problems. They are very communicative as well.
Best Persian Cat groomers in town

Thankyou to everyone at Pet Bath and Beyond! Jaxs is a Big Red Fox Lab and they always do a fabulous job with him! Sarah Samantha is 1.5 years old and she is Beautiful!! Thankyou again for loving and taking care of my Jaxs and Sarah Samantha ❤️
Love this place.   Great service and employees are so friendly.
Highly recommend. They always do a great job!
Pet Bath & Beyond was a great place to take my short-haired chihuahua for his monthly baths and nail trims. We used their services until we moved from the city.

I have been coming to Pet Bath and Beyond for years and have always been a loyal customer, spending over $200 every visit for my three dogs. Because of that, I’m extremely disappointed with my experience today.

We’ve always requested the same groomer, and if he wasn’t available, we understood. But this time, Danielle groomed my two babies and their hair was cut so unevenly and much shorter than requested. It honestly looks like it was chopped off.

What made it worse was the interaction when I picked them up—it felt rude and unprofessional, and I left feeling unheard and disappointed.

I understand there are new staff members and everyone is learning, and the girls up front were sweet, but when it comes to our fur babies, people trust that they’ll be cared for properly.

If you’re going here and have had a good experience with Max, I personally recommend requesting him.

I’m just really disappointed because I’ve trusted this place for years and expected better.
Drina is wonderful at grooming! So happy for our boy and us!
I gave instructions to the groomer servicing my dog and she exceeded the expected results. Chewbacca and I, thank you
Employees are friendly & helpful. Highly recommend this Salon.

My dog was groomed on a Saturday and upon picking her up I noticed razor burns and cuts on her belly. I called Monday since they are closed Sundays and mentioned my concerns. The receptionist asked me to send photos and the owner would call me. I already knew they would not take accountability just seeing some of the recent reviews. She mentioned that it’s likely my dog has allergies and I just didn’t know. Then when i questioned her she said next time ask for a hypoallergenic shampoo. My dog is 7 with no health issues and is kept indoors and clean …. Never has she been allergic to anything and never to shampoos used an any groomer she’s ever been at. The owner then said it’s maybe bug bites and when I said again that this was when I picked her up on Saturday and she said “well we don’t have bugs here.” Then she offered me basically some Neosporin to put on her and that I should then ask my vet her opinion …. Which I will not be doing unless they can cover her vet visit. Not to mention they added on the fulminator package without telling me or calling me which never occurs. My dog gets groomed regularly and brushed at home. I paid $100 for this service and now my dog is is uncomfortable and in pain. Wish I was atleast offered a portion of my money back or even accountability.
PET bath and beyond is the only my place I will take my dog. He loves it and he has been going there for 5 years now. Thank you guys. ☺️

This place should NOT be in business. They(Max)hurt my dog and blame the customer for their inadequacy. Inexcusable. Please do San Antonio a favor and shut down.The owner is a rude elderly woman who is not concerned with the care your pet receives. Check out these pics and see for yourself

The experience at this salon with the groomer Max was TERRIBLE.
From the beginning, Max seemed rushed and made me feel like my dog had severe matting, which I didn't contest because I felt rushed but I know he didn't because I trimmed his hair recently. Max didn't go over anything about my dog with me and said he would have to cut it very short without showing any length options.

This was our first and last visit. I am irate and disappointed that I trusted this groomer with my dog.

He is a 9-year-old labradoodle with a flat coat (not very curly), and they shaved him so close that his butt, inner legs, and genitals were excoriated. My dog is now acting sad and uncomfortable, and I feel terrible.
They refused to issue a refund but offered to “fix” the grooming. Even though he has no hair left to fix, aside from uneven straggling patches, the hair that was cut wasn't even cut well! They returned my tip and offered a free bath in the future, but I do not trust taking my dog here again.

It was obvious Max was rushing and did not consider my dog’s sensitive skin.
When I brought my dog back to show the owner, she tried to make excuses, claiming he was brought in in poor condition, which is not true.
If you value skill and care, do not bring your dog here — especially not to Max.
I’m fuming.

We love Pet Bath & Beyond! The only groomers I feel comfortable and satisfied taking my dog to, been taking him here for about 6 years now. My baby is always happy and looks perfect afterwards. I love the haircut report card pic they text! All the groomers here have been excellent every time. The front desk staff is always very friendly and accommodating. Today Karen was his groomer and she was wonderful! ☺️✨

I’ve been coming to this groomer for at least 6 years.   Sometimes they do an excellent job but lately the quality of the service has been atrocious.   On February 13, 2026 took my Yorkie for a full groom.  It seems like the groomer this time was either new or does not really know how to style or give a puppy cut to yorkies.   She chopped him up so bad that he now looks like a chichuahua.  His face doesn’t have shape nor form.  It seems she just grabbed the  clippers at went crazy.   I called back and instead of giving me a refund for the horrible job, they simply said I’m sorry.  Pathetic.  They lost a great customer.
Love love love!!  They are kind and easy to book with, as well as super professional! They do an excellent job grooming my bernadoodle.

I have been a loyal customer of this grooming place for two years, bringing my dog here every two weeks. During that entire time, I never once asked for my dog’s hair to be cut — only basic services such as a bath and very minimal cleaning.

During one visit, before they even handed me my dog’s leash, I immediately saw that her hair had been cut and asked, “Why did you cut her hair?” Everyone there said no — that they “only did a trim.” This was not a trim.

I am attaching before-and-after photos in this review so you can clearly see exactly what I am talking about. The difference is obvious. Despite what the staff kept telling me, my dog’s hair was clearly cut with clippers.

When I addressed this and spoke with the owner, they continued to deny it. Instead of taking responsibility, their only response was to offer me a refund. I never asked for my money back — and money was never the issue. $100 means nothing compared to honesty, accountability, and respect. All I wanted was a simple apology and an admission that a mistake was made.

No one apologized. No one admitted what they did. They refused to show me the security camera footage. The manager repeatedly dismissed the situation by saying, “The hair will grow back,” and the owner said the same thing while refusing to come to the store, even when I offered to wait so she could see my dog in person.

This behavior was unprofessional, dishonest, and unacceptable. After two years of trust, this experience completely broke my confidence in this business.

I will never return to this place — and neither will my friends. I truly hope that anyone reading this review will think twice after seeing the photos and understanding what happened. This business does not deserve to be supported.
Thank you so much for the 5-star rating! We truly appreciate your support and are grateful you chose Pet Bath & Beyond. It means a lot to our entire team.

Great service! I was skeptical at first because I’m cheap and usually bathe him in the backyard, but I’m in a walking boot now and it’s cold out. So pricing was on point with PetSmart grooming and other groomers and if doing mobile grooming also the same. Perth bath and beyond is just much closer to our house and it was so easy from start to finish! The report card with picture is nice to receive as well! We will definitely be using them again because it’s easier then the yard or clogging our drains at home!

I went to Pet Bath and Beyond for the first time today and had a great experience. Karen, my groomer, was excellent—very kind, professional, and clearly cares about the dogs. My pet looked amazing and was very comfortable afterward. It’s clear she truly loves what she does. Highly recommend!

Thank you for your 5-star review! We’re so glad you found our pricing reasonable and were happy with our dog grooming services. Providing quality care at a fair price is always our goal.

We truly appreciate your support!

My dog simply loves going to Pet Bath and Beyond. We used to be a client of one of the larger multi location brands and my dog would come home from boarding smelling awful and exhausted. After his boarding at this location he comes back alert, happy, and stable. On top of that, their bath/grooming package makes him smell amazing for at least a week after, and that's saying a lot for him in particular! They are a bit pricier but completely worth it. Staff is always super helpful. I only wish they had an option to pick up on Sundays to help reduce costs slightly.

Thank you so much for the 5-star rating! We truly appreciate your support and are grateful you chose Pet Bath & Beyond. It means a lot to our team.

Looking forward to serving you again,
Pet Bath & Beyond

I love it and my dog loves it too. People are very nice and friendly, Karen does a great job, I appreciate her work. I like how they send you a report via text and my dog would always smell good and very good looking. Thank you all!
Amazing experience! Winston my poodle got the best bath and groom — he looks adorable and smells so fresh. The groomer did a great job!! Highly recommend!  🐩 ⭐️ ⭐️
They always do a great job on my baby girl. This time I just went in for a nail trim and I asked them to please file so we’re not rough and they did just as I asked. I was in and out.

This would be my Shih Tzu’s second grooming. His first was done out of state so I didn’t have a place, until now. No doubt I’ll keep taking him to Pet, Bath, and Beyond. The girl at the front desk was very friendly. And the groomer was very knowledgeable. When I showed her a picture of him after his first grooming she right away said we can do the same style. And let’s not forget the excellent communication. They text you when your pet is ready and give you a full report of the service they provided. This is just an amazing place. And very eloquent inside as well. As far as the price goes I don’t have anything to compare it to, but I’ll still take my dog back even if I found a place that was less expensive just because of the amazing service.
My dog loved it
They make my pooch look like a movie star, each and every time
Great place and great staff. My Breezy told me.
Amazing grooming service! Highly recommend!
